title: Return to Snowy River VHS 1988 NEW Sealed Disney Home Entertainment
descriptionText: This product is a new, sealed VHS tape of the 1988 Disney movie "Return to Snowy River." Directed by Geoff Burrowes and starring Tom Burlinson, this adventure film falls under the action and adventure genre. Produced by Walt Disney Home Entertainment, this full-screen edition includes special features and is in NTSC signal standard. With a G rating and English language, this VHS tape is a must-have for fans of classic Disney movies and adventure films.
